note: City of Mountain Iron campground on the West Two River Reservoir: wooded sites, a boat landing, a fishing pier and a swimming beach. There is no dump station on site; the nearest is 5 miles away. The caretaker's office is open May to September; outside those months City Hall (218-748-7570) answers reservation questions. --Claude
summary: City page, rules PDF and CampLife read: open May 8 for 2026, reservations from March 1 on CampLife, caretaker 218-410-2327 all confirm the stored values; CampLife still has no 2027 dates loaded, so the 2026-10-14 rate estimates stand. Rules cap a site at 6 people. Not waterfront kept (sites under continuous canopy). Pin ~370 m off at the entrance.
flags: Pin move: stored 47.48067,-92.66398 is the park entrance on the rail line; the campsite loops are in the woods to the east-northeast on imagery. Proposed centroid 47.4822,-92.6597 (~370 m).

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The site spurs sit under continuous forest canopy; the shore band of trees is ~30-60 m deep between the eastern spurs and the reservoir (imagery 47.4815,-92.6595). No open ground to the water.

Extra people (not written, to keep the fees group's CampLife provenance intact): the rules PDF says 'a maximum occupancy of 6 persons per campsite' (fees.extra_person.max_people 6 if the reviewer wants it).
Rules PDF: one RV or sleeping unit plus one tent per site; two registered vehicles per site; cancellation 10 days before arrival with a one-night fee kept.

Note cleaned: dropped '45 wooded sites with electric only, flush toilets and showers' (sites, hookups and facilities fields hold them); caretaker months corrected to the city's 'May-September' (was 'mid-May to mid-September').
